_comment: Interior wall end pieces for gTileset_OrleansInterior (own art, make_caps.py). Each piece is a plain bottom-layer cell (layer type normal, behaviour normal, blocks like the cell it replaces). 'palettes' = the existing palette slot each 8x8 tile fits (no new colours).

gen_top_L.where: wall top row, left end (x=0, y=0)

gen_top_R.where: wall top row, right end (x=W-1, y=0)

gen_foot_L.where: wall lower row, left end: the pilaster's plinth at the floor (x=0, y=1)

gen_foot_R.where: wall lower row, right end (x=W-1, y=1)
